senses.gloss: शिव- + आदेशक शिव- + आदेशक, m. a fortuneteller, Mālav. 69, 13.
शिव- + दास शिव- + दास, m. a proper name.
शिव-रात्रि शिव-रात्रि, f. a festival in honour of Śiva.
शिव- + शक्ति शिव- + शक्ति, m. a proper name, Rājat. 5, 131.

शिव शिव (probably akin to शवस्),
 I. adj.
 1. Prosperous, Hit. 68, 17; auspicious, Mālat. 6, 12; happy.
 2. Right, Nal. 20, 17.
 3. 17.
 3. Comparat. शिवतर, Very complacent, Utt. Rāmac. 145, 2.
 II. m.
 1. Śiva, a deity of the Hindu triad, Kir. 5, 21; dual, Śiva and his wife, ib. 5, 40.
 2. The phallic emblem of Śiva.
 3. An auspicious planetary conjunction.
 4. The Vedas.
 5. One of the astronomical periods termed योगस्.
 6. A pillar to which cattle are tied.
 7. A sort of [] perfume.
 III. f. वा.
 1. Durgā, the wife of Śiva.
 2. The female jackal, Sāv. 5, 75.
 3. The name of several plants.
 IV. n.
 1. Happiness, Arj. 5, 19; bliss, Mālat. 160, 14.
 2. Wellbeing, Pañc. 16, 5.
 3. Final emancipation from separate existence.
 4. Water.
 5. Sea or fossile salt.
 --Comp.
शिवंकर शिवंकर, i. e. शिव + म्-कृ + अ, adj. Auspicious, conferring happiness.
शिवताति शिव + ताति, f. Benevolence, Mālat. 160, 4.

शिवि शिवि, m.
 1. A beast of prey.
 2. The name of a king, Sāv. 2, 17; MBh. 13, 2046, sqq.; pl. his descendants, Draup. 8, 3.

शिविका शिविका, f.
 1. A palanquin, a litter, Rām. 2, 60, 76, Seramp.
 2. A tent, Johns. Sel. 9, 12; a marquee.
 3. A proper name, MBh. 3, 13155.

शिविर शिविर,
 I. m. The name of a tribe(?), Rājat. 5, 176.
 II. n.
 1. A camp.
 2. A royal camp or residence.
 3. A guard or defence for the soldiers.
 4. A sort of grain.

शीवन् शी + वन्,
 I. m. The boaconstrictor.
 II. f. वरी, An iguana.
शिव- + संकल्प शिव- + संकल्प (m.), the name of a hymn, Man. 11, 250.

सिव् सिव्, i. 4, सीव्य, Par.
 1. To sew.
 2. To unite, Utt. Rāmac. 128, 5.
 --Ptcple. cf. the pf. pass. स्यूत.
 1. Sewn, Mālat. 77, 4; stitched, joined, made, Prab. 116, 8.
 2. Pierced by a fishing-book.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, अनुस्यूत,
 1. Sewn on (cf. अनुस्यूतत्व).
 2. Closely attached to.
 3. Uninterrupted.
 --Cf. सि; Goth. siujan; A.S. siwian; O.H.G. siut, suila, saum; A.S. seam, limbus; O.N. saumr, sutura; Lat. suere, Con-sus, Con-sualia; κασ-σύω, probably ὑμήν and Ὑμήν (cf. सीवनी, s. v. सीवन).

सीवन सीवन, i. e. सिव् + अन,
 I. n. Sewing, stitching.
 II. f. नी, The frenum of the prepuce.
शिव- + स्वामिन् शिव- + स्वामिन्, m. a proper name, Rājat. 5, 34.
